decision.question: Explain the outcome of the projected American grammars and dictionaries?
decision.resolution: Insert the exact approved short historical note after p6:s2, with sources and shared dictionary authorship; leave every translated sentence unchanged.

evidence.excerpt: Humboldt’s larger American project remained unfinished, although he left substantial grammatical studies, including a Nahuatl grammar (modern manuscript-based edition, 1994). The Nahuatl dictionary, published in 2000, was conceived by Humboldt but compiled and revised chiefly by Eduard Buschmann, who continued the work after Humboldt’s death.
